_comment: Wikimedia Commons sourcing plan for the itinerary days we own no photograph of — the 29 published days named in the day-image report, plus the draft Vienna maths trip's Semmering day so it is covered before publishing. Each entry carries the day's own subject, ordered search queries for the Commons API (most specific first), and the alt text to store. 'prefer' may list exact Commons file titles (File:...) to pin a choice after reviewing the dry-run contact sheet — a preferred title that exists and passes the licence check always beats a search result. Applied by fill-days-from-commons.mjs, which only ever writes days that still have no image.
